title: Conversion to a Finite Machine
statement: Let $c$ be an effective two-work-tape machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string. The finite machine obtained by converting the $K$-machine associated with $c$ at $\alpha$ is equal to the finite machine obtained by converting the code decoded from $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is an effective two-work-tape machine code
replaced:
Let $c$ be an effective two-work-tape machine code and let $\alpha$ be a binary string.
The finite machine obtained by converting the $k$-tape machine associated to $c$ at
$\alpha$ is equal to the finite machine obtained by converting the decoded code at
$\alpha$.
